message.content:
<think>The user wants to add a meeting with the marketing team tomorrow at 2 PM for one hour in the main conference room. 

I need to create an event with:
- Title: "Meeting with marketing team" (or similar)
- Start time: Tomorrow at 2 PM
- Duration: 60 minutes (1 hour)
- Location: "Main conference room"

I don't know the exact date, but "tomorrow" means the day after today. Today is January 15, 2025, so tomorrow is January 16, 2025. The time would be 14:00 (2 PM).

Let me create the event with this information.
</think>
